statement: The mixed-cache-and-SQL decision audit distinguishes dependency construction and publication from actual data access. The existing SeedRuntimeBridgeOwner acquisition function and equivalent renamed wiring are not mixed authority decisions; actual cache and SQL operations remain detected inside constructor arguments, publication calls, computed expressions and callbacks. constraints.statement: Repair only the existing mixed-cache-and-SQL classifier and its witnesses. No runtime changes, parallel audit, filename/function allowlist, blanket constructor/setter subtree exemption, or baseline increase.

Class names, object property labels, dependency handles and publication targets are not by themselves evidence of a truth read. Inspect evaluated expressions and operations, including computed keys and nested argument expressions; dependency-shaped wiring cannot hide cache and SQL reads.

Preserve existing mixed-read and all other-kind negatives. Measure unchanged revised tests against the old and repaired classifier using the authorized runner. Capture and independently inspect the full before/after finding identity delta so unrelated real findings are not silently waived. No whole-program or dynamic-JavaScript soundness claim.
